sections.frequently asked questions:
How do I install the plugin?

You can install the plugin by uploading the ZIP file via the WordPress admin dashboard or by placing the unzipped folder into the wp-content/plugins directory.

Is the plugin compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, the plugin has been tested with WordPress Multisite and is fully compatible.

Can I white-label this plugin?

Absolutely! The plugin includes full white-labeling support so you can customize branding for clients.
